title: A Wolf for the Crown
author: Xanthe Montrose
blurb: Petra Brightwater, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
